resources.string: Ledger reads incoming SMS from your bank and mobile-money providers (like CBE and Telebirr) so your spending is tracked automatically — you never have to type anything. Messages from anyone who is not a bank or telecom are ignored on your phone and never sent anywhere. Your financial messages are sent only to the Ledger service over an encrypted connection.
SMS access is required for automatic tracking. You can still use statement upload on the web dashboard.
